Senior engineer and master's supervisor at the Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). She serves on the institute's Youth Innovation Promotion Association council and as Party branch secretary and Youth League branch secretary in Division 8, the China Remote Sensing Satellite Ground Station. She studies frontier problems in intelligent remote-sensing image processing, focusing on image retrieval, remote-sensing data services, and the identification of global heat-emitting heavy industry. She has led more than 10 projects, including National Natural Science Foundation projects, and participated as a lead designer in more than 40 projects under the National Key Research and Development Program, the National 863 Program, and CAS Category A Strategic Priority programs. She has published approximately 60 research papers, including more than 50 SCI-, EI-, or CSCD-indexed papers as first or corresponding author, and 23 SCI-indexed papers, 17 of them as first or corresponding author. She has filed 13 invention patent applications as the first applicant, with 17 applications in total and eight granted patents, and obtained 12 software copyrights. Her honors include recognition as a Young Female Scientist by the China Association of Remote Sensing Application, membership of the CAS Youth Innovation Promotion Association, and selection for the institute's Future Star talent program. She also serves on committees of the Space Electronics branch of the Chinese Institute of Electronics, the women scientists' association of the China Association of Remote Sensing Application, and the Engineering and Equipment branch of the CAS Youth Innovation Promotion Association.
